verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a developer LLM API with key management and documented compatibility with the OpenAI and Anthropic protocols. That lets developers build against those vendors' SDKs pointed at Kimi, but no first-party Kimi SDK is evidenced. The probe also notes the API is a separate Open Platform product from the assistant app. Missing for 10: any official Kimi-branded SDK (language libraries, install/reference docs), SDK code samples, and independent hands-on corroboration of building with an SDK.
